PullRequest.Title: agentHost: snapshot the bundled managed settings schema
PullRequest.Body: Similar to prompts, track changes to the Managed Settings Schema through each SDK roll in case new keys etc. come up with that need to be integrated.

Scenarios.Scenario: Normal managed-settings schema snapshot comparison during the targeted or full Node integration-test run
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The test creates an isolated temporary home, starts one bundled Copilot runtime through CopilotClient, waits for one managedSettings.schema RPC, serializes the returned schema, reads and compares the committed snapshot, then stops the client and removes the temporary home. All of this is on this test's critical path, but it is test-only and does not affect editor startup or product runtime.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Create one isolated temporary home directory and recursively remove it after the test
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One mkdtemp and one bounded recursive cleanup per test invocation; the isolated home is new and contains only runtime state created by this single test
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: This test did not exist, so this scenario performed no temporary-home filesystem work
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Creation precedes runtime startup and cleanup precedes test completion

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Start and stop the bundled Copilot runtime through CopilotClient
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Exactly one client/runtime lifecycle per test invocation
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: This schema-snapshot scenario did not exist and started no runtime
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Startup must finish before the schema request; shutdown must finish before cleanup and test completion

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Request the complete managed-settings schema from the runtime
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Exactly one RPC after startup, with no loop or per-schema-property fan-out
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: No managedSettings.schema RPC was made by this absent test
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The response is required before serialization and comparison

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Pretty-print the complete RPC result as JSON
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One serialization of the current roughly 65 KB, 1,158-line snapshot per invocation; CPU and allocation grow linearly with future schema size
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: No schema serialization occurred in this absent test

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Check for and read the committed snapshot through existsSync and assertSnapshot
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One existence check and one snapshot-file read per normal invocation; teardown may enumerate the adjacent snapshot directory once through the existing snapshot harness
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Comparison is required for the test to pass

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One complete managed-settings schema per test invocation. Effective cardinality remains one runtime, one RPC, and one snapshot; there is no item loop, retry, or concurrent fan-out.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The test awaits startup, the single RPC, comparison, shutdown, and cleanup sequentially. It creates no Promise.all burst and no parallel per-key operations.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Every run intentionally uses a cold isolated home, so runtime state is not reused. The committed baseline is read once in normal mode; there is no miss retry or retained cache.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the changed test directly shows one client lifecycle, one RPC, one JSON serialization, and bounded filesystem operations.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Bundled-runtime startup duration varies by platform and CI load, but the work is bounded to one explicitly added integration test and the schema payload is currently small.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The added cost is intentional coverage on an integration-test path, is bounded to one runtime/request, has deterministic cleanup, and does not introduce product-path fan-out, retention, or unbounded work.

Scenarios.Scenario: Explicit managed-settings snapshot regeneration with AGENT_HOST_UPDATE_AHP_SNAPSHOTS=1
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The same isolated runtime startup and single schema RPC must complete, after which the test serializes the result, ensures the snapshot directory exists, writes one baseline file, stops the runtime, and removes the temporary home. This is a manually selected maintenance workflow rather than a default product path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Start and stop one bundled Copilot runtime
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One runtime lifecycle for the explicitly invoked update test
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: There was no managed-settings regeneration workflow
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Startup gates schema generation and shutdown gates completion

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Fetch the complete managed-settings schema once
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One RPC per explicit update invocation
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Required to produce the updated snapshot

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Create the snapshot directory if needed and write the pretty-printed schema baseline
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most one recursive mkdir and one roughly 65 KB file write per invocation
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: No managed-settings baseline file was generated
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The write must complete before successful test exit

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Create and remove the isolated temporary home
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One temporary directory lifecycle per invocation
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: No temporary home was created for this absent workflow
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Creation precedes startup and removal follows shutdown

Scenarios.ScalingInput: The complete schema size controls serialization and write cost linearly; invocation cardinality is one and only occurs when the explicit update flag/test is selected.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: All boundaries are awaited sequentially; no concurrent writes, subprocess burst, or request fan-out is introduced.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The isolated home is cold by design. Update mode writes the authoritative snapshot directly and does not perform the normal baseline read; no cache lifecycle is involved.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the update branch and cleanup are direct in the added lines, with exactly one write and one runtime lifecycle.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Runtime startup cost is platform-dependent, while the current output is approximately 65 KB; this maintenance command is explicitly invoked and infrequent.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The added work is explicitly gated maintenance work with fixed cardinality and complete cleanup.

Analysis.Summary: Reviewed all three changed files and the complete 1,158-line schema snapshot. The PR adds one bounded, test-only runtime lifecycle and schema snapshot workflow. No high-confidence performance regression was introduced, and the change does not fix a prior shipped performance regression.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
